issues.issue: The statement prints one Debt service line. Defensible because the fund columns 1,468,385+155,119+379,000 tie to the line; the split is marked computed/split_from.

The printed General Fund Total disbursements is 29,097,527. The extractor recorded 29,097,527 less the 851,600 hidden-transfer contra (marked computed), so the detail items tie. This is not the printed figure.

Nature unclear. Code 1955 is in the 1950s miscellaneous-local series, which may be payments from postsecondary institutions (intergovernmental/county/other local governments), not tuition. Already marked review; same applies to detail[10].

issues.on_page: Other receipts 19,272 (Depreciation Fund 'Other nonrevenue receipts', p13)
